message.reasoning_content:
The scene centers on a commission investigating a toll road burning. The player demands an investigation into the incident and summoning of those who profited.

The first spine scene requires a single irreversible state change. The player's sealed word to the commission will flip a specific fact from false to true.

The state change is the commission receiving the sealed word and deciding to investigate. The empty milestone means this scene establishes the investigation rather than resolving a prior goal.

The tactical move is to deliver the sealed demand to the commission. The precondition is that the commission has not yet received it.

The state change is the commission convening or accepting the sealed demand. The scene will show the player delivering the letter, then the commission acting on it.

The tactical move is to force the commission to address the burning by delivering a formal demand. The precondition is that no investigation demand has reached the commission. The state change is the sealed letter being delivered and read aloud in session. The player must choose between attending the summons personally or sending a proxy.

The state change is now the commission clerk breaking the seal and reading the demand aloud. The player must choose between demanding an immediate summons or allowing time for review.
